summary: Deployment inventory was updated with FAULT_LATENCY_MS set to 3000, causing inventory requests to take 3 seconds. Because webapp has an upstream timeout of 800ms for inventory requests, calls to webapp are failing with HTTP 504 timeouts. Rolling back deployment inventory to revision 1 resolves the latency and timeout issues.

claims.statement: A recent rollout on deployment inventory changed FAULT_LATENCY_MS from 0 to 3000.
Webapp upstream calls to inventory time out after 800ms due to the high response latency.
claims.quote: ERROR webapp upstream inventory timed out after 800ms url=http://inventory:8080/stock

claims.statement: Loadgen receives HTTP 504 Gateway Timeout errors when calling webapp.
claims.quote: WARNING loadgen GET http://webapp:8080/api/orders -> HTTP 504 after 814ms

guard_reasons: conflicting evidence: raw facts lack the signal ['high_error_ratio', 'upstream_failures'] required for config_regression on deployment/inventory
